control.description-key: Approval task in context - header, chain progress, decision buttons and the in-app signing session

property.name: ActionJson
property.description-key: The action the user chose, as JSON

property.name: DataJson
property.description-key: Approval task, correspondence and chain steps as JSON

property.name: SigningUrl
property.description-key: Signing session URL; set after the app requests a signature

property.name: CorrespondenceUrl
property.description-key: Address the Open correspondence link points at

property.name: ReturnUrl
property.description-key: Same-origin page the signing session returns to

property.name: Busy
property.description-key: Disables the buttons while the app is saving or fetching a signing link

property.name: ErrorMessage
property.description-key: Message shown in the dialog, for example when a signing link could not be created

property.name: Comment
property.description-key: The comment typed with the decision

property.name: SigningResult
property.description-key: completed, declined or closed once the signing session ends

property.name: ActionAt
property.description-key: ISO timestamp of the reported action, so repeated actions still raise OnChange
